name: Runner Extras - Event Subscriber Mutation
brief: Regression test: a var Rec mutation inside an OnAfterValidateEvent subscriber must propagate to the validated record.
description: Proves that when an [EventSubscriber(...OnAfterValidateEvent...)] receives the record by reference (var Rec) and mutates one of its fields, the change is observable on the record being validated — i.e. the subscriber aliases the live record, not a throwaway before-image.
